description: Portal sprites — the ONLY way to travel between maps. Place at map edges. Borders are impassable; portals override passability.
rule: Players cannot leave a map except through a portal. All map edges must be bordered with impassable border tiles. Portals are placed ON TOP of border tiles at designated crossing points.

usage.idle: portal_magic_idle or portal_fire or portal_ice — looping idle animation
usage.active: portal_magic_active — when player is near the portal
usage.enter: portal_enter — plays once when player steps into portal
usage.marker: portal_marker — floating arrow above portal to hint location
